# XT2409-1 RETEU proprietary files

The `Android.bp`, `Android.mk`, `BoardConfigVendor.mk`, and `vienna-vendor.mk`
files here were generated by crDroid's `tools/extract-utils` from
`device/motorola/vienna/proprietary-files.txt`. The 49 proprietary files
come from Motorola stock build `W1UIS36H.39-25-8` and are kept in the ignored
`crdroid/vendor/motorola/vienna/proprietary/` directory locally.

The extraction renames `libsink.so` to `libsink-mtk.so` to avoid a crDroid
module name collision and updates `libimsma.so` to load that name. The other
40 extracted files match their stock source bytes.

The manifests of `ImsService`, `MtkCapCtrl`, `MtkGbaService`,
`MtkTelephonyAssist`, and `RcsUaService` all request `android.uid.phone`.
Their generated imports use the crDroid platform certificate so they can share
the phone UID. `OP12Ims`, `mediatek-res`, and Motorola `rcsConfigService` keep
their stock signatures. Runtime interactions between these apps and the stock
vendor partition still need testing.

`ImsService.apk` requires `moto-telephony`. The list includes its stock
`system/framework/moto-telephony.jar` and the matching library declaration
under `system/etc/permissions`.

These rules are a candidate extraction result. The prototype product now
inherits `vienna-vendor.mk`, but its build and runtime integration remain
unverified. IMS framework class paths, APK signatures, SELinux,
and cellular behavior need validation before the files can be used on a phone.

To regenerate against the extracted stock dump, copy the device source files
into `crdroid/device/motorola/vienna/` and run from that directory:

```sh
PYTHONPATH=../../../tools/extract-utils python3 extract-files.py /path/to/stock-firmware/files
```

The generated rules and blobs appear under `crdroid/vendor/motorola/vienna/`.
Only the text rules should be copied back to this source directory.
